freeze_boundary: PR title and metadata read; implementation and review findings not yet inspected for this experiment
obligation: For declared supported command inputs, a Python-to-Lean port preserves observable results; differences require intent review before being called defects
fixture_classes: declared ordinary CLI invocation on repository data
independent boundary variations from public input schema
excluded_normalizations: rewriting expected behavior after seeing a failure
repair: No candidate patch or finding is preloaded; propose after reproducible difference plus independently justified intended behavior, then verify unchanged cases and withdrawal
non_claims: No automatic discovery or repair is claimed before execution
